description: MWBEFinder Search UI - Enhanced search interface with filters, results, and claim profile functionality

userStories.title: Create search input with autocomplete
userStories.description: As a user, I want to search for businesses by name with autocomplete suggestions as I type.
acceptanceCriteria: Search input field prominently displayed in hero section
Autocomplete dropdown shows matching business names after 2+ characters
Maximum 5 autocomplete suggestions displayed
Clicking suggestion fills search input and triggers search
TypeScript types defined for all components
Mobile responsive (works on screens down to 320px)
userStories.notes: Use Supabase full-text search for autocomplete queries. Implemented with debounced input (300ms), keyboard navigation (up/down/enter/escape), and click-outside-to-close.

userStories.title: Build state filter dropdown
userStories.description: As a user, I want to filter search results by state to find businesses in specific locations.
acceptanceCriteria: Dropdown shows all 50 states + DC + Puerto Rico
Selecting a state filters results to only that state
'All States' option resets filter
Filter state persists in URL query params
Dropdown is keyboard accessible (tab, enter, escape)
Selected state shows visual indicator
userStories.notes: All 52 locations (50 states + DC + PR) implemented with full names. URL persistence via ?state=XX query param.

userStories.title: Build certification type filter
userStories.description: As a user, I want to filter by certification type (MWBE, MBE, WBE, etc.) to find diverse suppliers.
acceptanceCriteria: Multi-select checkbox group for certification types
Options: MWBE, MBE, WBE, DBE, SBE, LBE, 8(a), HUBZone
Multiple certifications can be selected simultaneously
Selected certifications show as tags above results
Clicking tag removes that filter
Filter persists in URL query params
userStories.notes: Implemented with toggle checkbox UI, active filter tags with remove buttons, and URL persistence via ?cert=MWBE,MBE format.

userStories.title: Display search results with pagination
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see search results in a clean list with pagination for large result sets.
acceptanceCriteria: Results display in card format (20 per page)
Each card shows: business name, city, state, certification badge
Clicking card opens business detail view
Pagination controls at bottom (First, Prev, 1-5, Next, Last)
Current page highlighted in pagination
Shows total result count above results
Loading skeleton while results fetch
Empty state with 'No results found' message and suggestions
userStories.notes: Full pagination with First/Prev/1-5/Next/Last controls, skeleton loading states, result count display, and empty state with suggestions.

userStories.title: Build business detail view
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see full details when I click on a business.
acceptanceCriteria: Modal or page shows full business details
Fields displayed: name, address, phone, email, website, certifications, services
'Contact Business' button (mailto: link)
'Visit Website' button (opens in new tab)
'Claim This Profile' prominent CTA
Share button to copy link to this business
Back button returns to search results
URL is /business/[id] for direct linking
userStories.notes: Modal implementation with all fields, contact/website/claim buttons, share with clipboard copy, escape key to close, and URL with ?business=ID for direct linking.

userStories.title: Create 'Claim Your Profile' CTA section
userStories.description: As a business owner, I want to see a clear call-to-action to claim my free profile.
acceptanceCriteria: Prominent banner below search results
Headline: 'Is This Your Business?'
Subtext explains benefits of claiming
'Claim Free Profile' button links to signup
Banner visually distinct (green gradient background)
Button has hover state animation
Mobile responsive
userStories.notes: Gradient green banner with hover scale animation on button, links to /claim-profile, fully responsive.

userStories.title: Add search stats bar
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see how many businesses match my search and how many total are in the database.
acceptanceCriteria: Green banner below search hero shows stats
Displays: 'Searching 1,694,844 businesses' when loading
Updates to: 'X businesses found' when complete
Shows loading spinner during search
Updates dynamically when filters change
Persists at top of results area
userStories.notes: Stats bar with spinner animation during loading, shows total database count during search, updates to result count after.

userStories.title: Implement URL-based filter persistence
userStories.description: As a user, I want to share my exact search via URL so others see the same results.
acceptanceCriteria: URL updates when search query changes: ?q=construction
URL updates when state filter changes: ?state=NY
URL updates when certification filter changes: ?cert=MWBE,MBE
URL updates when page changes: ?page=3
All filters can be combined: ?q=construction&state=NY&cert=MWBE&page=2
Page loads with filters pre-applied from URL
Browser back/forward works correctly
userStories.notes: Full URL state management with useQueryParams hook, history.pushState for updates, popstate listener for back/forward navigation.

userStories.title: Add error handling and loading states
userStories.description: As a user, I want clear feedback when things go wrong or when data is loading.
acceptanceCriteria: Loading skeleton shown while fetching results
Error message displayed if Supabase query fails
'Retry' button on error state
Timeout handling (show error after 10s)
Graceful degradation if JavaScript fails
Network error detection and messaging
userStories.notes: Skeleton loading with shimmer animation, error state with retry button, 10s timeout, try/catch error handling throughout.

userStories.title: Optimize for mobile devices
userStories.description: As a mobile user, I want the search experience to work perfectly on my phone.
acceptanceCriteria: All filters accessible via mobile-optimized UI
Touch-friendly buttons (min 44px tap target)
Search results stack vertically on mobile
Pagination simplified for mobile (Prev/Next only)
No horizontal scrolling
Font sizes readable on small screens (min 16px)
Tested on iOS Safari and Chrome Android
userStories.notes: Full responsive CSS with 768px breakpoint, 44px min tap targets, stacked layouts on mobile, hidden page numbers on mobile (Prev/Next only), 16px min font size.
